name: What is the process for planning an accessibility-minded bathroom modification with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for planning an accessibility-minded bathroom modification with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your specific needs, preferences, and the existing bathroom space. We'll then provide a detailed proposal and design recommendations. Once the plan is approved, we handle all aspects of the construction, from demolition to final installation, ensuring clear communication throughout. Our goal is to create a functional and safe bathroom that meets your accessibility requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves a consultation, proposal, design, and construction, with ongoing communication to ensure your needs are met.
